definitions.explanation: The inside angle where two walls, sides, or edges meet. An interior corner of a room or space.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隅|すみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a bookshelf in the corner of the room.

examples.japanese: {隅|すみ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{隅|すみ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I cleaned from corner to corner (thoroughly).

examples.japanese: ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隅|すみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put it in the corner of the desk.

notes:
{隅|すみ} refers to interior corners (concave angles).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {隅|すみ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{隅|すみ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: from corner to corner, thoroughly
- {隅|すみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to put in the corner
- ⟦{隅|すみ}っこ→隅っこ：16361_sumikko⟧: corner (casual/cute form)

{隅|すみ} vs ⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧:
- {隅|すみ}: interior corner (inside a room)
- ⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧: exterior corner (outside corner, street corner)

Example:
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隅|すみ}: corner of a room (inside)
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧: street corner (outside)
